lines.en: I am a statue. I cannot walk.
My feet are fixed to the base.

lines.zh: 你要是看见我动了，那是你眼花。
lines.en: If you saw me move, your eyes deceived you.
Under the paint lies hard shell.
I have stood here for years.

lines.zh: 有人从我旁边经过，我不看。
lines.en: People pass me. I do not look.

lines.zh: 我的位置一动就是灾难。
lines.en: If my position shifted, it would be a disaster.
This pose aches in my neck.

lines.zh: 我在等一个永远不会来的班。
lines.en: I wait for a shift that never comes.
Something creaks under the floor.

lines.zh: 我只有一只眼睛能看见。
lines.en: Only one of my eyes can see.

lines.zh: 灯光扫过来，我又暗下去。
lines.en: The light sweeps over, and I dim again.

lines.zh: 我就这么站着，面无表情。
lines.en: I stand here, expressionless.
My teeth show and will not retract.
The fabric on me has rotted.

lines.zh: 我听这屋子里的每一次响动。
lines.en: I hear every sound in this room.
Dust has settled on me.
Someone watches me. I know.
My hat is askew. I cannot straighten it.

lines.zh: 我的影子和墙贴在一起。
lines.en: My shadow merges with the wall.
The night guard fears me most.

lines.zh: 灯泡一闪，我的眼睛亮了一下。
lines.en: The bulb flickers; my eye glints.
I count the hours and quarters.
There is a deep seam across me.
Someone touched my shoulder.
You are sizing me up?
I am only an ornament.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛没有在看别处。
lines.en: My eye is not looking elsewhere.

lines.zh: 这屋子里只有我一个不动。
lines.en: In this room, only I do not move.
A photograph? I dislike the flash.

lines.zh: 我站在这儿，就是在警告。
lines.en: My standing here is the warning.

lines.zh: 你知道我为什么不追你吗。
lines.en: Do you know why I do not chase you?
I cannot move, but I remember you.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，我闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell you.
My jaw has been clenched all along.
One step back. Satisfied.
The paint is flaking. Never mind.

lines.zh: 我只有十点血，可我扛得住。
lines.en: Ten points of life, and still I endure.

lines.zh: 摆件不会动，只会被光晃。
lines.en: An ornament does not move, only catches the light.
I need not move to frighten you.
Do not speak at me.
A chip of paint. That is all.
I do not cry out.
A new crack in the shell.
I do not even sway.
Ten points of life is enough to stand.
Dust sifts down from me.
I keep staring ahead.
That blow was wasted.
A corner of cloth falls away.
Still in this pose.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，这只是一座石膏。
lines.en: I do not eat; this is only plaster.
Set the food away.
You would feed a statue?
There is no mouth under this fabric.

lines.zh: 味道我闻到了，仅此而已。
lines.en: I smell it. That is all.
What you hold is not enough.
My teeth are not for chewing.

lines.zh: 我是雕像，这层漆底下是硬壳。
lines.en: I am a statue; under this paint is hard shell.

lines.zh: 我很多年没吃过东西了。
lines.en: I have not eaten in years.

lines.zh: 把它拿走，我看着不舒服。
lines.en: Take it away. It unsettles me.

lines.zh: 我不动的，是你撞上来了。
lines.en: I did not move. You walked into me.
My shell is hard as iron.
Dust fell off me when you hit.
I have not shifted an inch.
A chip of paint came off my shoulder.
Please go around.
The base is fixed.
I cannot even say sorry.
Do not touch my hat.
I am an ornament.
Such matters have nothing to do with me.
I cannot even turn my head.
My lips are painted on.

lines.zh: 我在这儿站到什么时候？
lines.en: How long must I stand here?
Leave.
My silence lasts longer than before.
Save those words for the living.
I cannot even bend.

lines.zh: 有只手从我旁边伸过去捡。
lines.en: A hand reached past me to get it.
I can only watch it be taken.
Pick it up for me.
It is dusty from me now.
I see it. I cannot move.
Something new on the floor.
These belong to the living.
Do not pile things at my feet.
I have no target.
I cannot fix on anyone.
My eyes can only look.
Put the weapon down.
No need to fight something like me.
Striking me is a waste.
I am only a hard shell.

lines.zh: 我记得你站在那里的样子。
lines.en: I remember you standing there.
Do not take me for an enemy.
I will not strike back.
Go ahead. I will not move.
This shell will break.
It is not really me you fear.
The lights are still on.
Come closer and I will watch you.

lines.zh: 我的视线跟着你转不了。
lines.en: My gaze cannot follow you.
You are behind me now.

lines.zh: 我听到你的脚步绕过来。
lines.en: I hear your steps coming around.
The seam on my back is splitting.
Will you take it out on me?
You are hesitating.
This room is too small.

lines.zh: 麦克风举着，我数你的脚步。
lines.en: Microphone raised, I count your steps.
Not the head.

lines.zh: 那层布下面有东西在响。
lines.en: Something rattles under the cloth.
Your hands are sweating.
My base blocks your path.
I do not move, and I do not yield.
Just so. Not too close.

lines.zh: 雕像的耳朵，也能听见你。
lines.en: Even a statue's ears can hear you.
I do not strike people.
All I do is stand.
Strike if you must. I will not dodge.
Another mark on the shell.
I will not raise a hand.

lines.zh: 你砍在我肩上，火花溅开。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder; sparks scatter.
My jaw is still clenched.
I have marked where that landed.
A flake of paint falls off me.
Save your strength.
My claws are cast in place.

lines.zh: 你砍我的手臂，纹丝不动。
lines.en: You cut my arm; it does not stir.

lines.zh: 这声闷响在屋里回了一圈。
lines.en: A dull boom circles the room.
Wood and iron shudder together.
I neither dodge nor meet you.

lines.zh: 灯亮起来，你就看见我了。
lines.en: The light came on, and you saw me.
I did not arrive. I was already here.
The dust was swept from my base.

lines.zh: 这间屋子里还有别人吗？
lines.en: Is anyone else in this room?
Dust settles on my hat, then on me.
I was watching when the door opened.
I chose a good spot to stand.
Count to three. I am still here.
My teeth are here waiting.
I will not leave.
I show clearest at night.
Someone wiped my face.
I am always at the same angle.
You came. Good.
I have held this pose too long.
Look at me.
The fire blisters my paint.

lines.zh: 我从台子上摔下来，碎了角。
lines.en: I fall from the base and chip a corner.
Water soaks my wood. It will rot.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀歪，我慢慢正回去。
lines.en: The blast tips me; I settle slowly back.
A bullet lodges in my face.

lines.zh: 光在我身上绕，可我不动。
lines.en: Light coils over me. I do not move.
Wood needs no food.
Lightning strikes; my whole frame rings.
The base is gone, and so am I.
